# Adriano Belisario

[Data, journalism, and open-source technologies for social impact.]{.hero-tagline}

Combining expertise in communication, open-source technologies, and data to address important social concerns. Currently collaborating with the [Joint Data Center on Forced Displacement](https://www.jointdatacenter.org/) and the [Netlab](https://netlab.eco.ufrj.br/) laboratory from the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro. MSc in Social Data Science from the Oxford Internet Institute (University of Oxford).
